# PerchTV 0.1.27

Captions for MP4 videos on Samsung televisions.

## WHAT CHANGED

- On Samsung televisions, an MP4 video sent from Perch with its own captions now shows them while the television's caption setting is on: each line appears at its time and goes when it ends, and none is left on screen after a stop or a skip. Videos whose captions the television already showed keep working as before.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- A film that ends, ends; live TV still recovers on its own if the picture freezes; Voice Guide on Samsung televisions; and up to eight phones.
